column3: Amazon  fails to exercise its extension option on 50% or more of its leased premises at the earlier  of (a) nine-months prior to its then current expiration date and (b) the date on which it  is required to provide its notice exercising its extension option (which, for the avoidance  of doubt, is 15 months prior to its lease expiration with respect to the leased premises  occupied by Amazon AWS);
